subject: Social Media
title: AI and Political Speech
description: A 60-second lesson on AI and Political Speech.

hook.text: An AI generates 10,000 personalized political emails in an hour. Each sounds handwritten. Each pushes a specific view.

buildup.text: Large language models produce propaganda at scale. One operator can flood comment sections with unique, human-like text.

discovery.text: In early tests, people couldn't tell AI-written arguments from human ones. The Turing test for politics has been passed.

twist.text: AI doesn't just write propaganda. It also detects it. The same tools that create manipulation can flag it.

climax.text: The arms race between AI-generated and AI-detected content will define the next decade of political speech online.

punchline.text: Machines now write opinions. And judge them too.

quiz.question: What makes AI-generated political content especially dangerous?
options: It's indistinguishable from human writing at scale
